notes: I1-I3 met: volumetric (Sieverts) H2 uptake vs time at 303 K and 16 bar for pristine MWCNTs and five B-doped CNTs (Fig. 10, Tables 5, 8, 9). First failing criterion is I4: no specific surface area for any sample anywhere in main text or SI, so code no_surface_area. The only 'surface area' mention is about a cited MOF study (Table 1, ref. [34]). Inconsistency in the paper's stated conditions for the 0.497 wt% maximum: abstract says 273 K and 16 bar, Results text once says 303 K and 20 bar, while Characterization, Fig. 10 and 11 captions and Table 9 header say 303 K and 16 bar. Paper cites the authors' earlier BCNT H2 work (ref. [25]) but does not state that these uptake values were published before; duplicate_data not applied. Primary research article; not retracted.
